stops.title: Attendance reports
stops.caption: Per week, per branch.
stops.speech: Attendance reports show check-ins per week against distinct members, which separates the same people coming often from more people coming.

stops.title: Who is missing
stops.caption: Sorted by how long.
stops.speech: The missing members list is sorted by how many services somebody has missed in a row, which is the list pastoral care actually needs.
